Add an `export-json` command requiring `--path` and accepting optional `--status pending|completed`. +function Write-JsonArrayAtomically {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Items
+    )
+
+    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
+    }
+
+    $temporary = Join-Path $parent ".$([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Path)).$PID.$([guid]::NewGuid()).tmp"
+    try {
+        $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Items) -Depth 8
+        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, "$json`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+        [System.IO.File]::Move($temporary, $Path, $true)
+    }
+    finally {
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary) {
+            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force
+        }
+    }
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/export.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $exportStore = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'export-source.json'
    $exportTasks = @(
        [ordered]@{ id = 10; title = 'Tenth task'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-10T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 2; title = 'Second task'; description = 'Café'; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 1; title = 'First task'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' }
    )
    $sourceJson = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $exportTasks -Depth 8
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exportStore, "$sourceJson`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $sourceBeforeExport = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($exportStore)

    $textDestination = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'new/parent/all-tasks.json'
    $textExport = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $textDestination, '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($textExport.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json text mode should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $textDestination) 'export-json should create a missing parent directory'
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)
    $textLines = @($textExport.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True (($textLines[0..($bannerLines.Count - 1)] -join "`n") -eq ($bannerLines -join "`n")) 'text export should display the banner exactly once'
    Assert-True ($textLines.Count -eq ($bannerLines.Count + 1)) 'text export should contain one banner and one summary line'
    Assert-True ($textLines[-1] -eq "Exported 3 task(s) to $([System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($textDestination)).") 'text export should return a stable count and destination summary'
    $allExported = @([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($textDestination) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($allExported.id -join ',') -eq '1,2,10') 'export-json should order tasks by numeric ID'
    Assert-True ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($exportStore) -ceq $sourceBeforeExport) 'export-json should not alter task storage'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($textDestination, 'OLD DESTINATION')
    $replacement = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $textDestination, '--data-file', $exportStore, '--json')
    Assert-True ($replacement.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json should replace an existing destination'
    $replacementSummary = $replacement.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($replacementSummary.exportedCount -eq 3 -and $replacementSummary.destination -eq [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($textDestination)) 'JSON summary should contain exported count and destination'
    Assert-True (-not $replacement.Output.Contains('EXPORT')) 'JSON summary should not contain the banner'
    Assert-True (-not [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($textDestination).Contains('OLD DESTINATION')) 'existing destination content should be replaced'
    Assert-True (@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $textDestination) -Filter '*.tmp').Count -eq 0) 'atomic export should not leave temporary files'

    $filteredDestination = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'completed.json'
    $filtered = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $filteredDestination, '--status', 'completed', '--data-file', $exportStore, '--json')
    $filteredSummary = $filtered.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    $filteredTasks = @([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($filteredDestination) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($filtered.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $filteredSummary.exportedCount -eq 1) 'status-filtered export should report its exported count'
    Assert-True ($filteredTasks.Count -eq 1 -and $filteredTasks[0].id -eq 2) 'status-filtered export should contain only matching tasks'
    $filteredBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($filteredDestination)
    $strictUtf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
    $decodedExport = $strictUtf8.GetString($filteredBytes)
    Assert-True (-not ($filteredBytes.Length -ge 3 -and $filteredBytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $filteredBytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $filteredBytes[2] -eq 0xBF)) 'export-json should write UTF-8 without a BOM'
    Assert-True ($decodedExport.Contains('Café')) 'export-json should preserve UTF-8 task content'

    $emptyStore = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty-source.json'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($emptyStore, "[]`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $emptyDestination = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty-export.json'
    $emptyExport = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $emptyDestination, '--data-file', $emptyStore, '--json')
    Assert-True (($emptyExport.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).exportedCount -eq 0) 'empty export should report zero exported tasks'
    Assert-True ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($emptyDestination).Trim() -ceq '[]') 'empty export should write a JSON array'

    $invalidExisting = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid-existing.json'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($invalidExisting, 'KEEP THIS')
    $invalidStatus = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidExisting, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($invalidStatus.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should reject an invalid status'
    Assert-True ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($invalidExisting) -ceq 'KEEP THIS') 'invalid status should not change an existing destination'
    $invalidMissing = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid/new/tasks.json'
    $invalidMissingResult = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidMissing, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($invalidMissingResult.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $invalidMissing))) 'invalid status should not create a missing destination parent'
    $invalidCase = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidMissing, '--status', 'PENDING', '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($invalidCase.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $invalidMissing))) 'status values should use the documented lowercase spelling'

    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $missingPath.Output.Contains('Missing required option: --path')) 'export-json should require --path'
    $samePath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportStore, '--data-file', $exportStore)
    Assert-True ($samePath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should reject task storage as its destination'
    Assert-True ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($exportStore) -ceq $sourceBeforeExport) 'rejected storage destination should leave task storage unchanged'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    $assetLines = @($bannerText.TrimEnd("`r", "`n").Split("`n") | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimEnd("`r") })
    Assert-True ($assetLines.Count -eq 12) 'export banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '[^A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=\-]' -or $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner should use only allowed characters without trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('EXPORT') -and @($bannerBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner should be ASCII and contain EXPORT'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $bannerText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'export banner should end with exactly one newline'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
